move_tensors_to_cuda: move a sample containing tensors to a CUDA device using move_to_cuda
move_tensors_to_cpu: move a sample containing tensors to CPU using move_to_cpu with float16 conversion
clip_grad_norm: clip gradient norms across model parameters using clip_grad_norm_ with optional aggregate function
apply_function_to_sample: recursively apply a function to all tensors in a nested sample using apply_to_sample
resolve_max_positions: resolve max position constraints from multiple sources using resolve_max_positions with dict or tuple args
